context_requirements: Plant-specific auxin transport machinery (PIN/ABCB carriers, TIR1/AFB receptors) that human cells lack
Intact plant auxin signalling and vascular differentiation programmes
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine human lines
Shared transcriptional signature across lines that matches known human drug classes rather than being absent
Evidence of target engagement of the annotated human proteins (ATP5A1/ATP5B/ATP5C1, HCK, PIM1, PIK3CG, STK17B) producing downstream transcriptional effects

evidence.supports: NPA, a polar auxin transport inhibitor, acts on plant auxin signalling and xylem transdifferentiation, a plant-specific process
NPA modulates plant BRX plasma membrane-to-nucleus translocation, demonstrating plant-specific mechanism of action
NPA affects plant root quiescent centre mitotic activity and root cap differentiation, again plant-specific
